hero.subtitleHTML: Project Nidos takes companies off spreadsheets and onto systems that run the business — CRM, automation, integrations and AI from the problem to a measurable result, at a fixed scope and price.

items.title: CRM Implementation
items.body: Customer data and sales work are spread across different places and systems. The result: one CRM and a sales pipeline you can see through.
bullets: Sales process audit and platform selection

items.title: Sales Process Automation
items.body: Leads go missing and follow-up is done by hand. The result: an automated journey from first interest to closed deal.

items.title: Customer Service Automation
items.body: Replies are late and staff answer the same questions again and again. The result: centralised support with a knowledge base and AI assistance.
bullets: FAQ knowledge base and AI assistant
Automatic classification, escalation to a person

items.title: Warehouse and Accounting Integration
items.body: The same data has to be entered into several systems. The result: orders, stock, invoices and customer data stay in sync.

items.title: AI for a Specific Process
items.body: People spend their days on repetitive work. The result: a measurable reduction in time, cost or errors.
bullets: One process assessed end to end
Working prototype, integrated with one system

items.title: E-commerce and Payment Integration
items.body: The online store and the payment flow are not properly connected to the rest of the business. The result: a secure, connected order, payment, delivery and accounting flow.
bullets: Stripe, SEPA, Apple Pay, Google Pay

about.heading: From first call to fully running system.
about.bodyHTML: We don't leave after the presentation. We stay until the system works — CRM brings order to sales, ERP connects your processes, and reports generate automatically. Our team is led by systems architects who have delivered these systems before.

items.claim: One partner for the full cycle

items.support: We know which EU digitalisation programmes apply

contact.heading: Let's talk.
contact.lede: Not sure where to start? Start with a free 20-minute call.
contact.infoBody: Tell us what you want to digitalise, and we'll propose a solution.
